title: More Than 1,000 Mathematicians Join New Association to Shun AI-Generated Research
summary:
Members of the newly formed Association for Human Mathematics (AHM) have pledged to reject the use of artificial intelligence in publishing mathematical papers and to avoid collaborations with frontier AI labs. More than 1,000 mathematicians have joined the organization, while 654 of those members committed to avoiding all AI tools in their research.

The movement has drawn criticism from observers who describe the mathematicians' resistance as a case study in how not to handle the AI transition. Other critics argue the effort to create AI-free spaces is futile, claiming the technology has already reached escape velocity in the field of mathematics.
